# Disagreement Log — 1 Kings Chapter 18
**Reviewed by:** SOPHIA | **Date:** 2026-03-11

---

## Summary
1 verse(s) flagged for significant translation divergence.

### Verse 1
**EMET (literal):** And-it-was many days, and-the-word-of YHWH came to-Elijah in-the-third year, saying, "Go, show-yourself to-Ahab, and-I-will-give rain upon the-face-of the-earth."

**LOGOS (formal):** After many days the word of the LORD came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, show yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the earth."
**2** So Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria.
**3** And Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. Now Obadiah...

**PNEUMA (dynamic):** Much later, in the third year of the drought, the LORD said to Elijah, "Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain."
**2** So Elijah set out to see Ahab. The famine in Samaria was desperate by now.
**3** Ahab had summoned Obadiah, his palace administrator. Obadiah was a deeply devout man ...

**SOPHIA resolution:** The divergence reflects translation philosophy differences rather than disagreement about the Hebrew text. LOGOS adopted as consensus baseline.

---

— SOPHIA
